content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Sɑnsom u seewɑ u dɑ Tinnɑɔ. Mɑ u bii kurɔbu ɡɑɡu wɑ mi, Filisitibɑn bii wɔndiɑbɑ sɔɔ, ɡɑ nùn wɛ̃re.
Ye u wumɑ u win tundo kɑ win mɛro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ bii kurɔbu ɡɑɡu wɑ Tinnɑɔ Filisitibɑn bibu sɔɔ. I mɑn nùn kɑsuo n suɑ kurɔ.

Win tundo kɑ win mɛro bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, tɔn kurɔbu sɑriwɑ wunɛn mɛro bisibu sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ bɛsɛn bweseru sɔɔ, ɑ kɑ dɑ ɑ kurɔ kɑsu Filisitibɑ sɔɔ be bɑ ku rɑ bɑnɡo ko mi? Adɑmɑ Sɑnsom u win tundo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ mɛ, ɑ mɑn nùn kɑsuo domi u mɑn wɛ̃rewɑ.
Win tundo kɑ win mɛro bɑǹ yɛ̃ mɑ ɡɑri yi, yi weewɑ sɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn min di, domi swɑɑ u kɑsu u kɑ Filisitibɑ sɑnnɑ. N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Filisitibɑrɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn yinnibu.
Yerɑ Sɑnsom u seewɑ u dɔɔ Tinnɑ mi kɑ win tundo kɑ win mɛro. Ye bɑ turɑ Tinnɑɡibun dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑrɔ, miyɑ Sɑnsom u ɡɛrɑ mɑ ɡbee sunɔ kpɛmu ɡɑɡu ɡɑ nùn kɛɛnu ɡuremɑ subɑru sɔɔ ɡɑ kukirimɔ.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Gusunɔn Hunde u nùn yɔɔwɑ mɑ u ɡbee sunɔ ɡe nɛnuɑ u yɑkɑnɑ kɑ win nɔmɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ boo buu yɑkɑnɛ. Adɑmɑ uǹ win tundo kɑ win mɛro sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye u kuɑ.
Mɑ u doonɑ u dɑ u kɑ kurɔ wi ɡɑri kuɑ. Kurɔ wi, u nùn wɛ̃re ɡem ɡem.
Sɔ̃ɔ mɛɛrun biru Sɑnsom u kpɑm sɑrɔ mi kɑ win tundo kɑ win mɛro u kɑ win kurɔ suɑ. Mɑ u ɡɛrɑ ɡbee sunɔ ɡoo ten mi, u tu mɛɛrɑ. Yerɑ u deemɑ wee, tĩi yi mɔmɑ te sɔɔ, yi tim koosi.
Mɑ u nɔmɑ kpɛ̃ɛ u tim mɛ wɔwɑ u dimɔ swɑɑɔ. Ye u win tundo kɑ win mɛro nɑɑmwɛ, u mɑɑ bu wɛ̃ bɑ di. Adɑmɑ uǹ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ ɡbee sunɔ ɡorun diyɑ u tim mɛ wunɑmɑ.
Sɑnsom u Filisitibɑ
sukuru kuɑ
Mɑ win tundo u dɑ kurɔ win yɛnuɔ. Miyɑ Sɑnsom u kurɔ kpɑɑ dĩɑnu kuɑ domi mɛyɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑ bɑ rɑ ko.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Filisitibɑ bɑ wɑ mɛ, mɑ bɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑ tɛnɑ kɑsu bɑ dɑ bɑ kɑ nùn sinɑ.
Mɑ Sɑnsom u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kon bɛɛ sukuru ɡɑru kuɑ. Sere n kɑ ko kurɔ kpɑɑ ten sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru, kpɑ i mɑn tu tubusiɑ. Ì n tu tubɑ, kon bɛɛn bɑɑwure yɑberu kɛ̃ kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ yɑ̃nu.
Adɑmɑ ì kun tu tubɑ bɛɛyɑ i ko mɑn ye kpuro wɛ̃. Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, oo, ɑ sun tu kuo, sɑ swɑɑ dɑki.
Mɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Dɑmɡiin min diyɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ duronu yɑrɑ.

content: Mɑ bɑ kpɑnɑ bu suku te tubusiɑ sere n kɑ kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑ.
Yen biru bɑ Sɑnsom kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn durɔ kɔkirio u kɑ sun suku te tubusiɑ. À n yinɑ, sɑ ko bɛɛ dɔ̃ɔ mɛni, wunɛ kɑ wunɛn yɛnuɡibu kpuro. N ǹ i sun sokɑwɑ i kɑ bɛsɛn yɑ̃nu wɔrɑ?

Mɑ Sɑnsom kurɔ u nɑ u sumɔ win wuswɑɑɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn kɑm mɛɛrɑwɑ. Aǹ mɑn kĩ. A nɛn tɔmbu sukuru kuɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɑǹ mɑn tu tubusie. Mɑ Sɑnsom u nɛɛ, suku te nɑǹ nɛn tundo kɑ nɛn mɛro tubusie, wunɑ kon sere tu tubusiɑ?
Mɑ u sumɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere Sɑnsom wuswɑɑɔ. Ye n kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiruseru yerɑ u nùn suku ten tubusiɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Domi wuri yi, yi den nùn wɑsirɑ. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u dɑ u nu win tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Yerɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiruse ten yokɑ tɔn be, bɑ Sɑnsom sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: mbɑ n do n tim kere.
Nɡe mbɑ n dɑm mɔ n kere ɡbee sunɔ.

content: Mɑ Sɑnsom u nɛɛ, ì kun dɑɑ kɑ nɛn kurɔ sɔmburu kue nɡe nɑɑ wuku, iǹ dɑɑ suku te tubu.
Yɑnde Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u nùn yɔɔwɑ mɑ u dɑ u Asikɑloniɡibu ɡo tɔnu tɛnɑ tɔn durɔbu tɔnɑ. U ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ u be bɑ win suku te tubɑ wɛ̃. Mɑ u ɡɔsirɑ win bɑɑn yɛnuɔ kɑ mɔru.
Yerɑ bɑ win kurɔ wi suɑ bɑ ɑluwɑɑsi tɛnɑ yen turo kɑ̃ wi u kuɑ win kurɔ kpɑɑ sɑro.
Sɑnsom u Filisitibɑ
mɔru kɔsie
